column6: Facil y rapido is the objection being pre-answered; she assumes at-home means complicated.
Three reactions in quote marks and nothing measured; the crowd is standing in for a result she cannot verify.
Already sold on IPL and now picking a tier; the case and the finish are what the upgrade actually buys.

column2: The Sceptic Who Wants A Diagram
column6: The truth about is aimed at someone who suspects the category is overstated; the coat is the concession.
A man in a towel in his own bathroom; the lack of production is the entire credibility mechanism.
Day in the life of a Navy attorney sells the job first and the razor second.
Shot through the shaving mirror, mid-stroke; the technique is the content.
Your friend who is a share button disguised as an ad; he is being invited to tag someone.
Three reasons is a listicle for a man who does not yet know a dedicated tool exists.
Five rotating heads photographed beside the box; the form factor is the argument against a razor.
Black object on white, no copy; at this point the buyer only needs to see which one it is.
Filmed over his own scalp with people in the room; the ordinariness is what makes it look easy.

column6: Billie Labs and put to the test borrow the language of testing for a razor nobody can test.
If your kitty looks like this or this is a diagnosis offered in slang so she can accept it.
Shave, wax or grow it out refuses to pick a side; the neutrality is what keeps the whole segment in.
Buys the pouch with everything in it rather than choosing; the kit is a decision she does not have to make.
Gynecologically tested is the only line that matters; the rest of the design exists to be trusted quickly.
The argument is by analogy, not by benefit; if you already do it for your face the objection is gone.
Like a serum for your face but for your hands is a whole category built out of a habit she has.
Hands rubbing in silence; absorption is the only claim and it is being shown rather than said.
